name: Altibox
verdict: A fibre broadband brand of Lyse Tele, part of the Lyse group owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities; public regional owners without a sourced record.
note: Rating note: Left-sleeve patch (black circle with white altibox wordmark). Lyse AS is owned by 15 municipalities; state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md) and no record was found for the owner municipalities, so 'none'.
